content: Jacob José-masmalagi ise-nued binsasad
Iche-naded-sorbali, Joséʼga sokarmalad, be-bab uellemaiye. Geb degine, José e-bab-daknaded. José, e-masmala-warbogwad, Manasés, degi, Efraín, eba sesa gusad.
Jacob-owisosmargu, be-machi-José be-dakdaniye, Jacob na gandik imaksad, degi, e-gabedgi sigisad.
Geb degine, Jacob Joséʼga sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, Canaán-yargi, Luz-neggweburgi, anse magaros gusad. Agi, angi ise-nued-binsaedgi anga sogsa gusad:

‘Nue be an-itoye, mimmigan-bukidar-nikuega an be-imakoye. Degine, begi dulemar-bukidar-galagwensuli-ainiega an imakoye. Deginbali, be-waganga we-yala an ukoye. We-yalade be-wagangadga degisadegu guoye.’

”Nabir, be-machi-Efraín, degi, be-machi-Manasés, an bese we-Egipto-yarse-nonikid-iduar, we-yargi gwalulesmalad. We-masmalade angadid. Igi Rubén, degi, Simeón an-masmala-sunnadi, wemarde deyob gunonimarmogad.
We-masmala-warbogwad-sorba be mimmigan-nikuoedi, adi, begadga guoed. Amardi Efraín, degi, Manasés-e-urbamarsoggu, e-iamarba ibmar nikumarmogoed.
An Padan-Aramʼgi danigua, Canaán-yargi be-nan-Raquel Efrata-neggweburse-warmakdanikidgi angi burgwisad. A-igarba an e-mui digsad. Emigindi, Efrata-neggweburde Belénʼye nugad.”
Israel ukiar José-e-masmala-dakargu, egichided: —Wemardina, ¿we doamala?

José e-bab-abin sogded: —We-masmala, Bab-Dummad anga we-Egipto-yargi uksadid. Geb degine, e-bab Joséʼga sogded: —Be-masmala wis gatik anse walikaa be nidage, adi, ise-nued-an-egi-binsaedgi ibmar ega sogegar.
Israel bato nue selebagusad, nue-aku atakgusad. Bar nue-ataksursoggu, José e-masmala e-babse walikaa sesad. Israel masmala-angaagwar-gasgua, ei wagar usad.
Geb degine, Israel Joséʼga sogded: —Bar-be-dakosurye an bienad. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad be-masmala-dakega an-imaksad.
José e-masmala e-bab-Israel-yokor-imbaba-gwichidi onosad. Geb degine, José e-bab-asabin e-bebe napase-warmakedse imaksad.

Geb degine, José e-masmala-warbogwad e-argangi gasad, Efraín, e-argan-nuedsik, degi, Manasés, e-argan-sapiledsik gasad. Geb agine, gannar e-bab-Israelʼse walikaa sesad. Agala, Efraín Israel-argan-sapiledsik gwisgusad, degi, Manasésʼdi Israel-argan-nuedsik gwisgusmogad.

Israel, e-argan masmalagi-mesidgu, e-argan muchub biir imaksad. Degisoggu, Israel e-argan-nued machi-bipigwad-Efraín-nonogi mesisad. Manasés-bur-dummad-inigwele, Israel e-argan-sapileddi, Manasés-nonogi mesisad.
Geb degine, Jacob Joséʼgi ise-nued-binsaedgi ega sogded:

content.text: Degine, Abraham-e-nug, degi, Isaac-e-nug ebinsaledii wemarba gumarsun.

content: Ar Joséʼdi, e-bab Efraín-nonogi e-argan-nued-mesisadi, gwen nabir daksursoggu, José e-bab-argan-nued gasad, Efraín-nonogi-maidgi onirisad. Geb José e-bab-argan-nued Manasés-nonogi mesnaigu, e-babga sognaid:
—¡Baba, suli, weyobsuli! We, bur-dummadid. Be-argan-nued we-nonogi be mese.

Ar e-bab-Jacobʼdi yapa deyob imakgusad. Geb José-abin sogded: —¡Machi, bato an wisi! Ar Manasés amba dule-nue-nug-nikadga gumogoed. Degi-inigwele, e-urba-Efraínʼdi bur bule nug-nika guoed, degi, e-wagangi dulamar-bukidar akar-akar ainidagoed.
A-ibagi, Jacob we-masmalagi ise-nued-binsaedgi ega sogded:

content.text: Weyob sogmaloed: ‘Bab-Dummad, igi Efraín, degi, Manasés-imaksa,

content: Weyobi Israel, Efraín bur Manasésʼba nug-dummarba imaksad.
Geb degine, Israel Joséʼga sogded: —Nue be itogo. An burgoed. Ar degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad bemarba gudii guoed. Bab-Dummad bemar-dadgan-yarse gannar bemar-sedoed.
Be-gwenadganba an bega bur bule ibmar uked. An bega Siquem-yala uked. We-Siquem-yarde Amorreo-dulemargi an bila-onosgu, an-egi-nakwisadba an ei susad.
